info.name: Cryptomator vaults
info.summary: Open your Cryptomator vaults in the browser; the password never leaves it
info.description:
Browse, preview and download the files of a Cryptomator vault stored in your Nextcloud, without installing Cryptomator.
- **Unlocked in your browser:** the password and the vault's keys stay in the browser tab; the server only ever sends the encrypted files, as it does for Cryptomator itself - **Locks itself** after 15 minutes without use, when you choose Lock, or when you close the tab - **Finds your vaults** in your files, or opens one by its folder - **Read only:** nothing is written to the vault; use Cryptomator to change it - Vault format 8 (Cryptomator 1.6 and later), both cipher combinations
Not affiliated with Skymatic GmbH, the makers of Cryptomator.
info.author: Dawid Ciepiela
